name: numeral-tic
description: Counts the spelled numbers a manuscript leans on, per chapter and overall, so a repeated-numeral tic can be found and swept. Prose says 'eleven wagons', not '11 wagons', so spelled forms are what it counts; compounds like 'forty-one' are counted whole rather than as their parts, and 'one' is excluded because it is a pronoun far more often than a quantity. Reports uses per thousand words so a long chapter is not flagged merely for being long, and names the chapters where a sweep buys the most. Counting only - it never edits and cannot know which figures are load-bearing, so the judgement stays with a person. Feed every chapter of the book in one call.

topN.description: How many numerals to report per chapter. Default 8.

minRate.description: Uses per 1,000 words at or above which a numeral counts as leaned on. Default 2.
